# Funngro
India's #1 teen freelancing platform connecting smart teenagers with real companies.

## For Teens
Teens can register for free, complete an evaluation project, and start applying for real work from 4000+ companies. Projects range from social media marketing, content writing, design, to app testing. Every completed project earns real money and an experience certificate.

## For Companies
Companies can hire smart teens for short-term projects. Teens are tech-savvy, creative, and eager to learn, making them great for digital tasks, user testing, and campus ambassador roles.

## Contact
Website: https://funngro.com
